captions: A scarf for your mother. $18? Too much.
You walk away. He calls you back. $15.
At the gate, a boy with a tin box. “For the orphans.”
Your hand finds your pocket. Then stops. “Next time.”
You turn back. The boy is still there.
$3. The ones you fought for. Into the box.
Your pocket is lighter. Your chest, somehow, too.

post.caption:
20 minutes of haggling to save $3. $0 given for Allah this month. 🤍

The fear of “not enough” is loud. His promise is louder.

“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” (65:3)

Before Isha tonight: give something. Even $3.
